assets.rationale: The flat-spacetime Penrose diamond and asymptotic regions are readable.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_14.png
assets.rationale: The conformal metric remains visible as the null condition is introduced.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Light rays move on paths of zero interval.
